To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the proposed ANFISIS adaptive network based fuzzyinference system) architecture and learning procedure is an extension of the conventional fuzzy inference system, and that the proposed ANFISS architecture can construct an inputoutput mapping based on both fuzzy if then rules and input output data pairs, which is the main difference with earlier work on fuzzy modelling.
ANFIS is a useful tool for modeling complex nonlinear systems and for solving complex nonlinear optimization problems.

ANFIS (a) is a fuzzy inference systems implemented in the framework adaptive network; (b) is able to construct an input output map based on human knowledge and stipulated input/output pairs; (c) can be used to identify nonlinear functions and nonlinear components in control system; (d) can be used for prediction of chaotic time series; and (e) can be used in other applications such as signal processing, automatic control and so on.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a systematic procedure for constructing a fuzzy inference system, which is based on both human experts knowledge (in the from of if-then rules) and stipulation of input-output data.
the development of a systematic approach for constructing a fuzzy model from input output data.
the development of an intelligent system that is able to construct a nonlinear mapping from the input space to the output space based on the human knowledge and input output data pairs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed ANFUS architecture and the learning procedures are very useful in modeling, control and signal processing.
ANFIS provides an efficient and effective tool for constructing fuzzy models directly from the input output data pairs.
ANFIS is a promising tool for modeling and control of nonlinear systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ANFIS provides a framework for fuzzy modeling in which both the premise and the consequent of the fuzzy if then rules are identified in the same framework.
the proposed ANFIFs can be used as an intelligent system for modeling and control.
ANFIS is a universal approximator, which is a combination of neural networks and fuzzy systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a fuzzy inference system with a suitable learning algorithm can serve as a universal estimator.
fuzzy modeling and neural networks are complementary rather than competitive approaches to modeling complex nonlinear systems.
a hybrid learning procedure can be applied to a fuzzy inference system, which combines the advantages of human consistency and computer efficiency.
